# AGENTS.md — 14-fine-dining

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Ombre**, fine-dining restaurant, style "Dark luxury, candlelight".
- Stack: HTML, CSS, GSAP + ScrollTrigger. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `content.js` — courses with photos + Russian copy (English lives in the HTML)
- `main.js` — language switch, menu sync, GSAP choreography with no-GSAP fallback
- `styles.css` — tokens at the top
- `index.html` — page skeleton and English copy

## How to run
- `open index.html   # or any static server: npx serve .`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Pinned tasting menu: a sticky photo and roman numeral change with every course you scroll past.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- All photos pass through one CSS filter (`--grade`) so any stock image matches the mood.
- Gold is for numbers, eyebrows and links only — never for large fills.
- Roman numerals number the sections and courses.
- Motion is slow (1–2.6 s) and eased with expo/power curves; nothing bounces.
- Without GSAP or with reduced motion the page must remain complete.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
